description: This file defines a fragment class extending SwipeRefreshListFragment that demonstrates how to implement pull-to-refresh functionality with SwipeRefreshLayout in an Android app. It manages a list of cheeses, refreshes data asynchronously, and provides menu options to change the refresh indicator's color scheme.
external_files: R (resource file for layouts and menu items)

classes.name: SwipeRefreshListFragmentFragment
classes.description: A fragment class demonstrating swipe-to-refresh functionality with options for changing refresh indicator colors and updating list content asynchronously.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, enabling options menu.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the list adapter with dummy data and configures the swipe-to-refresh listener.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu with refresh and color scheme options.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections to trigger refresh or change color schemes.

methods.name: initiateRefresh
methods.description: Starts the background task to refresh list data.

methods.name: onRefreshComplete
methods.description: Updates list data and stops the refresh animation after background refresh completes.

methods.name: DummyBackgroundTask
methods.description: An AsyncTask that simulates data loading delay and generates new dummy data.
